subject: Node labels incorrectly shown for tips

messages.author: b5040293c686adc0
messages.subject: Node labels incorrectly shown for tips
parts:
Hi Guangchuan et al., 

I would like to display node labels (posterior probabilities or the "probpercent" feature) on a phylogeny produced from a Mrbayes analysis. Before reading the tree in ggtree, it was first modified with Figtree (attached here). 

I ran the following commands, and I got a PDF file (attached). Everything looks fine, except that every tip has a "100" label. Those should not be there. Why did this happen? How I can remove the "100" labels from the tips? Or is there another way to properly show the node labels? Thanks!

tree.mrbayes <- read.beast("allcompat.con.figtree2.nex")

ggtree(tree.mrbayes, right = TRUE) + geom_label(aes(label=probpercent, fill=probpercent), cex=15) + geom_tiplab(aes(color=grepl("BEP.", label)), cex=18) + theme_tree2(legend.position='right') + xlim(0, 0.5) + ggsave("mrbayes.pdf", width=80, height=100, limitsize = FALSE)

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Node labels incorrectly shown for tips
parts:
tree con_all_compat = [&R] (‘Candidatus_Paraholospora_nucleivisitans_EU652696.1’[&length_mean=0.2439176531195835,prob=1.0,prob_range={1.0,1.0},prob+-sd=”100+-0”,length_95%HPD={0.1931587,0.2957282},length_median=0.2429085,prob_stddev=0.0,probpercent=”100”]:0.2429085,

If you open the tree file, indeed you can find that alll tips have probpercent=”100” and ggtree do the correct things to label what you want.

If you only want to label internal node, use geom_label2 function which supports subsetting.

Bests,
G~

​
